topic:
bro fleet TUI + builtin-tool rendering UX polish (operator feedback, surfaced while driving the classifier-"intern" research vehicle on feat/fleet-classifier-intern). Three items:

(1) Activity throbber — the TUI needs a live "working" indicator for BOTH the executor AND its classifier/intern companion, so the operator can see at a glance when each is actively in a turn vs idle/waiting. Today turn-in-flight is derivable (turn_active in TaskSnapshot) but not surfaced as motion; long autonomous turns look indistinguishable from a hung/idle session. Want a spinner/throbber on the roster row (and single-agent header) for any agent whose turn is active — and the hidden classifier companion's activity should be visible too (it currently has no roster presence).

(2) Roster: drop the cost column ("cost theatre") and reclaim that screen real estate for `report`-tool teasers — show the latest builtin `report` message per agent (a one-line status of what it's doing / needs) instead of a running $ spend figure. Cost is low-signal for live driving; the report teaser is what the operator actually wants to scan. (Roster columns today: glyph·prov·name·model·cost·turns·started·last — fleet_tui.rs draw_roster.)

(3) Tighten builtin-tool rendering in the verbose transcript: compact tool calls to a single-line `tool(arg1, arg2)` form — positional args, no arg-name labels except where the value is non-obvious (then key=value). Current rendering (fleet_tui.rs render_transcript ToolCall arm) prints "⏺ name" then a multi-line pretty-printed JSON args block, which is noisy. Want e.g. `⏺ smart_read(src/knowledge.rs)` / `⏺ shell_run("cargo test --lib")` on one line.
notes: (4) Composer line-wrap / overflow — long input in the dispatch/steer composer gets obscured. The composer is a fixed COMPOSER_HEIGHT=3 block (≈1 visible content row after borders); draw_composer already sets Paragraph::wrap(Wrap{trim:false}), so text wraps but only the first wrapped row is visible — the rest, including where the cursor is, scrolls out of sight. Want the composer to keep the active input (and cursor) visible for multi-line / long input: either grow the composer height with content up to a cap, or scroll its viewport to pin the cursor line. (fleet_tui.rs draw_composer + COMPOSER_HEIGHT.)

(5) Model + effort selection in the TUI. Today the provider selector (Zone::ProviderSelector / FLEET_PROVIDERS / draw_provider_selector / cycle_provider) picks only the PROVIDER; model and effort are never operator-selectable — dispatch hardcodes them (DispatchSpec.model/effort are wired but only the classifier sets effort via fleet.json; dispatch_current_input leaves both None). Want: (a) at provider-pick time, also choose model + effort for the next dispatch (extend the selector zone or add a sticky-next model/effort like next_provider); (b) inline in the single-agent view, change model/effort mid-session — AgentHandle::set_model already exists (control_request set_model, fleet.rs); add the effort equivalent and expose both as e.g. /model and /effort slash commands or a picker. Anchors: fleet_tui.rs draw_provider_selector / dispatch_current_input / zone_slash_commands; fleet.rs AgentHandle::set_model.

(6) AskUserQuestion machinery (or a homegrown replacement) — route it accurately instead of silently skipping. Observed: fleet executors repeatedly emit AskUserQuestion, but in headless stream-json mode there's no answer channel, so it falls back to "skip" — the executor asks the operator a question that silently no-ops, then proceeds (or stalls) as if dismissed. Want a real round-trip: when an executor emits AskUserQuestion (or a homegrown question primitive), the TUI surfaces the question + options, the operator answers, and the answer is injected back as that tool's result so the executor continues on the chosen branch. Relates to the existing builtin `report` needs_input → Waiting-bucket signal (a poor-man's version); AskUserQuestion is the structured, multi-option case. Decide: intercept/answer the native Claude AskUserQuestion in the harness/fleet seam, or define a homegrown ask primitive bro-harness emits that fleet answers. Anchors: bro-harness agent_loop.rs (tool dispatch / bidi loop), fleet stream-event handling + Waiting/needs_input derivation (fleet.rs derive_stream_state), fleet_tui.rs composer/zone for the answer UI.
